'''Pickerin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Pickerin was visited by the [[Hand of Judgment]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] team after hearing word that the government there had [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] local artisans.{{Planet-stub}}
